say:1:1430402301:1.text: Now that the dragon's gone, there won't be any more echorites...
say:1:1430402301:1.source_cn: 龙飞走了，以后也不会再有深岩晶了……
say:1:1430402301:1.male: Now that the dragon's gone, there won't be any more echorites...
say:1:1430402301:1.female: Now that the dragon's gone, there won't be any more echorites...

say:2:1430402302:1.text: But I barely have enough to even forge a small hammer...
say:2:1430402302:1.source_cn: 可我现在手里攒下的深岩晶，连锻造一把小锤子的量都不够……
say:2:1430402302:1.male: But I barely have enough to even forge a small hammer...
say:2:1430402302:1.female: But I barely have enough to even forge a small hammer...
